scope: Edit Supplier_Invoices from the existing Edit button. Supplier and settlement membership remain unchanged. Credit notes and posted/cancelled/reconciled records require a separate correction workflow.
oauth_endpoint: Existing supplierinvoice_register OAuth endpoint dispatches operation=edit to private helpers.
coherence: Recompute VAT, withholding, totals and payable using two-decimal rounding.
Preserve payments and their allocations; reject reductions below their reserved amounts or prepayment allocations.
Update invoice Paid/Partially Paid status from verified payments and corrected payable.
Update existing settlement allocations; rebuild totals without adding service costs a second time.
Plan existing unposted accounting entries before writing; create and verify new lines with unique revision keys before removing prior lines; verify final balanced totals.
Refresh linked Card_Purchases.Invoice_Number when the invoice number changes.
Supplier_Invoice_Lines are informational booking-service snapshots; editing invoice header amounts does not redistribute those service costs.
Suppress workflow triggers for controlled writes; derive related state explicitly.
recovery: Server-side Edit_Request keeps an immutable correction plan and before-values; Edit_Status tracks Pending/Complete/Discarded separately from financial Status.
Conditional writes use If-Unmodified-Since; repeat requests reuse the same operation key.
A five-minute lease avoids concurrent retries; a caught failure releases it.
Before invoice mutation, a rejected correction can be discarded; after mutation it must be resumed or reviewed.
Widget and production guards block payment creation/allocation changes and manual accounting sync while a correction is pending; widget deletion also blocks.
Native CRM edits and unrelated external integrations do not share this operation lock. Conflicting changes stop recovery for review.

validation.browser_checks: Desktop and 390px mobile; required fields/reviews, expense recalculation, settlement allocation, file chooser/upload, save refresh and lost-response recovery.
validation.deluge_compilation: All new and modified functions accepted by Zoho.

remaining: User packages and uploads updated widget.
Validate embedded-widget access with the intended finance profile and save a controlled correction; inspect invoice, allocation, settlement and accounting records.
Existing repository-wide deletion failures involving missing Supplier_Pay_Allocations.Payment_Accounting_Status are separate from this feature.
